scopeNote: Three completed tests: five virtual-data apps, ten SharePoint-connected apps and five complex multi-prompt apps. Compare model settings within each test; the three scopes are not pooled.
app: Device Procurement and Availability; Device Lifecycle Hub
unitNote: Observed Cowork task credits, not currency or a tenant invoice. Final cumulative readings are not added to initial readings.
timingNote: Observed build time per app sums the authoring turns: build, planned updates, clarifications and corrections. It excludes external review and screenshot-taking gaps between prompts, /cost commands and native self-review. Within-turn waits and observation uncertainty remain included; this is not pure model compute time. Missing authoring coverage is not estimated from elapsed test time.
evidenceNote: Exact prompts, visible transcripts, app screenshots, approval records, backend snapshots and raw cost evidence are retained privately. Public data is an explicit allowlisted projection, not a raw transcript export.
